q: colon cancer surgery
a:
• Palliative vs Radical Surgery

  • Radical surgery  tumor resection + lymph node resection + reanastomosis

    • Right Hemicolectomy  ileo-transverostomy

    • Segmental Colectomy or Transverse Colectomy  colic-colic anastomosis or transverso-rectostomy

    • Left Hemicolectomy  transverse-sigmoidostomy or transverse-rectostomy

    • Sigmoid Segmental Colectomy  colorectal anastomosis

  • Palliative can be internal bypass or external diversions

    • Internal Bypass  ileo-transverostomy, transverse sigmoidostomy

      • Based on location of stenosis

    • External diversions  Colostomies (cecal, transverse, sigmoid) or Ileostomy
